description.value: Bartholomew's Public House, known locally as Bart's, has been a Victoria institution since 1975 and is located one block from the Inner Harbour with its entrance on Humboldt Street. Reopened under new management in 2020 with a Gastro English Pub direction, it runs 26 rotating craft draught taps and claims the largest gin selection on Vancouver Island. A touring cyclist finishing a day's ride near the Inner Harbour would find a lively, full-service pub serving fresh pub classics alongside a premium drinks program.
